profile.headline: Software Engineer and Owner at NXC Systems
profile.summary:
Experienced Technical Leader with a passion for software architecture excellence based on S.O.L.I.D. principles and Agile Methodologies.  Proven mentor who knows how to lead teams to be self-sufficient, driven, and effective. Decades of experience using TDD to reduce time to market, increase code quality, and drive product and process excellence. 

Decades of experience developing embedded real-time multi-threaded applications on a variety of hw platforms and OS's (linux, QnX, MacOS windows, bare-metal, freeRTOS, uCos), 

Expert in debugging HW and software issues via debuggers, core dumps, log dumps, bus traces, logic analyzers, and oscilloscopes.

Decades of experience developing in C, C++, and assembly.

Expert in Medical devices development practices and processes to adhere to IEC 62304.

positions.title: Software Engineer and Owner
positions.description:
NXC Systems is an embedded systems design company founded by industry veterans. Drawing from our experience in studio and live sound products, medical products, and SSD storage products, we are pleased to bring professional solutions to a variety of markets.  

Whether you need a few hours of contracting help or are looking for a full ODM or OEM solution, NXC has the skills, resources, and experience to meet your needs.

Checkout our website at https://nxcsystems.com

positions.title: Senior Principal Software Engineer / Senior Technologist
positions.description:
Software Architect, Team leader, and TDD Evangelist on a Solid State Drive development project with over 200 developers.

Lead in the development of an ASIC simulation framework to allow parallel development of the software and ASIC designs.
Lead in the creation of the Unit Testing and CI frameworks that successfully maintained code quality and prevented regressions in functionality.
Lead several SCRUM teams in design and implementation of critical features.
Creator of many days of video training's for on-boarding developers on various code modules and aspects of the system

positions.title: Principal Embedded Software Engineer
positions.description:
Software Architect and Team lead on development of the new generation of FilmArray instrument.

Created the initial Software Development Process to satisfy IEC 62304 for developing embedded software for medical devices at BioFire

Lead definition of software Architecture, Software requirements, and Software Specifications from Design Inputs and System Requirements.

Lead creation of Verification and Validation documents and created a CI pipeline that generated much of the traceability information to satisfy the requirements.

Lead the software design and implementation of FilmArray-2 from inception to production and worked with manufacturing and RMA's to increase manufacturability and create tools and processes to accelerate debug of device issues.

positions.title: Lead Staff Embedded Software Engineer
positions.description: Multi-processor embedded systems used in Industry leading professional audio processing equipment.

patents.title: Method and apparatus for storing data in a removable cartridge
patents.description: An information storage device (10, 510, 610, 710) includes a cradle (12, 512, 612, 712) which can removably receive a cartridge (11, 411, 511, 611, 711). The cartridge contains a rotatably supported disk (91, 326-327), and a pivotal actuator arm (101) which supports a read/write head (107, 331-334) for movement adjacent the disk. A coil (117) on the arm interacts with an external magnetic field to effect pivotal movement of the arm. The cartridge may contain a spin motor (92) for effecting rotation of a disk. A preamplifier (111) and an electrostatic discharge buffer (112) are provided for the head. A connector (71) is provided to electrically couple external circuitry to electrical components within the cartridge.
